project_type: Full-stack monorepo: React SPA frontend (Vite + Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui) with Express API backend, PostgreSQL via Drizzle ORM
build_system: pnpm workspaces monorepo. Root build: pnpm run build (typecheck + recursive build). Frontend: artifacts/creatools/ (Vite). Backend: artifacts/api-server/ (esbuild bundle). DB schema: lib/db/
test_framework: No test framework configured - validation via typecheck and build
verification_instructions: 1. Run pnpm run build from workspace root. 2. Verify frontend builds to artifacts/creatools/dist/public. 3. Verify backend builds to artifacts/api-server/dist/index.mjs. 4. Check docker-compose.yml has NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 and no healthcheck.
setup_instructions: pnpm install from workspace root (node_modules already present)
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. pnpm 9 via corepack. Node 22. No Docker daemon available for building but docker-compose.yml must be correct.
contribution_requirements: All frontend code in artifacts/creatools/src/. All backend routes in artifacts/api-server/src/routes/. DB schema in lib/db/src/schema/. Docker config in infra/.
key_patterns: Frontend: wouter router, React Query, authFetch utility, lucide-react icons, shadcn/ui components in components/ui/, pages export default function. Backend: Express Router per feature file, requireAuth/requireAdminMiddleware guards, authFetch on frontend calls BASE_URL + /api/ prefix. Schema: Drizzle ORM pgTable definitions, text IDs, exported from schema/index.ts. CSS: Tailwind v4 with :root HSL vars, .dark class, glassmorphism utility classes (glass-card, neon-glow-cyan, gradient-text etc).
directory_structure: Root: pnpm workspace. artifacts/creatools/ = React frontend (pages/, components/, context/, hooks/). artifacts/api-server/ = Express backend (src/routes/, src/lib/). lib/db/ = Drizzle schema. infra/ = Docker/nginx.
